quality_mode_description.exclude_low: Mode A: quarters whose underlying metrics are not quality_flag=ok are removed from the test and listed in excluded_quarters with a reason (DR-04.8, FR-52).
quality_mode_description.label_low: Mode B: derived quarters with identity_ok=true are kept and labelled; low-quality quarters with any other reason are still excluded (DR-04.8, FR-52).

holm_family: Two Holm families are stored: lag (company x x-variable x y-variable, m=5) and BT-wide (company x BT, m=30 for BT4); the stricter BT-wide family drives decision.
warnings: BT4/BT5: every x and y series is ADF-tested; when either is non-stationary at level, both series are first-differenced before Spearman and the effective n is reported.
Holm correction is stored for the lag family (m=5) and the company-wide BT family (BT4 m=30, BT5 m=5); the stricter BT family drives decision.
A BT4/BT5 result is called reject_h0 only when the strict Holm family rejects and the level/first-difference/permutation sensitivity check is not fragile; otherwise exploratory.

Quality mode B (label_low) is primary; A (exclude_low) is the sensitivity analysis. Only derived quarters with identity_ok=true are retained in B; other low-quality reasons are excluded in both modes.
n after YoY/lag/differencing is reported; n < 30 means reference only.
